history_summary: Add supported GTDB correspondences for the existing YL-JM2C and JMP134 descriptors
history_details: Preserve the source's YL-JM2C species-reference boundary and exact JMP134 NCBI synonym identity. Native reference populations are seven genomes/fraction 0.86 and one genome/fraction 1.0, respectively; no new study-stock assembly identity or biological mechanism is inferred. Only the two taxonomy GTDB blocks/statuses and two native inline events changed. All existing stock notes, source quotations, interactions, limitations and prior history remain unchanged. Scoped database and provenance correction; full scientific approval and corpus QC are separate.
